blocks.text: `std.fs` works with the file system independently of the operating system. Writing, `fs.write_string_to_file(path, text)`, gives a `bool`; reading, `fs.read_file_to_string(path)`, gives an `Optional[string]`; there are also `fs.file_exists` and `fs.remove_file`. If you need more detailed error information, `File.open`/`File.create` in `std.io` give a `Result`.

blocks.q: What does `fs.read_file_to_string` return when the file is not found?
blocks.why: The return type is `Optional[string]`; absence is reported with `None`.
